# Flywheel Storage (Flywheel)

> **Class**: `Flywheel` | **Module**: `energysim.models.storage` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Flywheel kinetic energy storage system for high-frequency regulation.

Round-trip efficiency is split symmetrically (sqrt(eta) each way) and the
rotor self-discharges proportionally to its SoC. SoC is limited to
[0.01, 0.99] by scaling the request.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'Flywheel'` | - | - |
| `power_max_mw` | `float` | `0.5` | MW | - |
| `energy_capacity_kwh` | `float` | `125.0` | kWh | - |
| `soc_init` | `float` | `0.5` | 1 | - |
| `roundtrip_eff` | `float` | `0.9` | - | - |
| `self_discharge_pct_hr` | `float` | `1.0` | %/h | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_cmd` | MW | - |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_actual` | MW | - |
| `SoC` | 1 | - |

## Validity and notes

Validity: seconds-to-minutes duty cycles; no speed-dependent power limit
or bearing/windage model beyond the lumped self-discharge.

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import Flywheel

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('flywheel', model=Flywheel(), outputs=['P_actual', 'SoC'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['flywheel'].tail(2))
```
